jobs.name: Mojito Metallique
jobs.scene: One adult Filipino woman's hand with short coral nail polish is lifting her golden-yellow MOJITO METALLIQUE from a partly open deep-red canvas crossbody pouch resting at her hip. Close crop from mid-ribcage to upper thighs, no shoulders/head at all. She wears a rich golden-yellow ribbed cotton top and dark indigo denim skirt. The bright red pouch, yellow shirt and small cobalt-blue headphone earpiece clipped at the far side give a playful color story; only ONE headphone set, no camera or sunglasses. A single chunky clear-amber resin bangle on wrist. Warm hard sunlight, authentic bag zip and denim weave. Warm coral painted wall above provides clean top space. Bottle mostly out of pouch, entire base visible over pouch front; held upright at center, label uncovered. WHITE/CREAM MOJITO METALLIQUE label, golden-yellow liquid. Woman only.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create one NEW photoreal editorial lifestyle photograph for DearBody Philippines. PORTRAIT 4:5, about 1200x1500. Full bleed photograph, no typography overlay.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the EXACT product identity reference. Images 2 and 3 are the owner's mandatory visual-theme references, which you must interpret for their bold, playful editorial advertising energy. Do not copy their layouts, poses, accessory combinations or individual scenes. Particularly use tightly cropped hand/body lifestyle framing, real photographic flash, glossy tactile color, vivid warm color blocking, expressive accessories and a clearly visible perfume.
NO FACE ANYWHERE: hands, arms, torso or legs only of ONE adult Filipino person, correct gender below. Crop from shoulders down or close overhead. Absolutely no head, chin, lips, eyes, face fragments, reflections, mirrors, portraits, phone-screen faces, people in background or artificial human silhouettes. Natural warm Filipino skin texture, realistic five-finger hands and grip.
PHOTOGRAPHY: looks photographed for a lively fashion/fragrance campaign, real cotton/denim/leather/chrome and natural pores. Crisp direct sun plus gentle flash fill, graphic but physically plausible shadows, rich saturated color. Dominant WARM red/coral/orange/yellow/cream/burgundy surfaces, SKU accent color secondary. No beige lifestyle stock-photo mood, hazy filtered light, washed-out neutral palette, CGI/plastic rendering, fantasy splash or floating product.
FRAMING for final ad typography: top 26% should be relatively calm warm-colored cloth/wall/surface with space for an offer card; no product or vital fingers there. The ONE HERO BOTTLE goes in central zone x28-75%, y42-72%, entire cap and base visible and never touching edges, roughly 26-33% of image height. Keep bottom 13% mostly quiet warm color/cloth for scent name and CTA later. Tight creative editorial crop: product, hands, bold styling and one or two personal objects carry the image.
PRODUCT: faithful small palm-sized 50ml tall straight cylindrical clear-glass bottle, restrained rounded shoulder, thick clear base, fitted glossy black cylindrical cap with an ALL-BLACK lower edge. Only a thin silver neck collar below the cap, no silver cap ring. Copy exact label color, print, shape, proportions, name and liquid from image1. Label faces camera unobstructed, fingers below or beside the words. Do not change names, products, volume or mechanisms. No canister. No additional perfume bottle. Only existing physical label text, no invented brand names, signs, overlay text or watermark. No ingredient imagery or performance claims.
